body: Could you please provide a minimal reproduction? Here's a template to get you started https://plnkr.co/edit/tpl:AvJOMERrnz94ekVua0u5

Checkout this plunker: (open in new window to see the URL changes)

[https://plnkr.co/edit/xT92m1lGjoGCM3EVa6TG?p=info](https://plnkr.co/edit/xT92m1lGjoGCM3EVa6TG?p=info)

It might also just be a documentation error. As I believe it may be standard convention to have the fragment at the end of the URL. Either way it is not behaving as it should according to the documentation.

This is an issue with the documentation, which should be updated to show the fragment part last.
```
         foo://example.com:8042/over/there?name=ferret#nose
         \_/   \______________/\_________/ \_________/ \__/
          |           |            |            |        |
       scheme     authority       path        query   fragment
```
 https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3986#section-3

issue.body:
In routerLink if a fragment is added than fragment example shows that it is added before the params '/user/bob#education?debug=true' but actually they are added after that '/user/bob?debug=true#education' changed documentation to show correct example

Fixes #18630
